derived_outputs.safe_area_note: The 1280x960 image spans y=60..1020, 12 px beyond the proposed text-safe band (72..1008) at top and bottom. The band governs essential text; no text is added. The 2x integer scale was chosen over a non-integer fit to keep the 1992 pixels crisp.
